==moving==
Just FYI there is a "move" button at the top that simplifies moving pages from e.g. Zarine to [[Faile]].  It keeps the page history, which is nice, and will automatically create a redirect for you.

==categorizing summaries==
The "Chapter Index" boxes were designed partly so that categorizing individual summary pages <u>as being summary pages</u> would be unnecessary (and redundant).  But if we do decide to categorize them as such, it will be most easily done from [[Template:Summary]] itself :) --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 10:00, 3 May 2006 (UTC)

==black ajah spoilers? and other reversions==
What in the world did I do wrong with my edits why was it reverted back? --[[User:Mjcarrier|Mjcarrier]]
: I also do not think noting black ajah members is too much of a spoiler.  If you don't want to be spoiled, don't read the lists.  It's pretty clear what they are; Mjcarrier's edits seem fine to me.  I am however a bit annoyed that he felt the need to start the same discussion on each of the Ajah's talk pages... no one wants to talk about the same thing in so many places.  Contacting Rccarman here to resolve the issue was the right thing to do... --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 00:54, 23 May 2006 (UTC)
: EDIT: oh, I just noticed [http://wot.wikia.com/index.php?title=The_Eye_of_the_World/Chapter_1&diff=prev&oldid=6693 this reversion] by Rccarman.  I also have no idea why that was done.... are we missing something, Rccarman, or was this a mistake? --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 01:02, 23 May 2006 (UTC)
:: It seems to me that naming the members of the Black Ajah in an area that is purportedly a listing of members of the Red Ajah is a major spoiler.  It certainly ruined a couple of surprises for me.  Since that information will be contained in the article for each person anyway, why does it need to be here too?
::: I suppose it's arguable whether the mentions of Black Ajah on the other Ajah pages are useful.  Maybe [[Black Ajah]] can cover everything. --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 22:52, 23 May 2006 (UTC)
:: I also seem to recall reading a style guide somewhere that was not in favor of these extensive hideously detailed lists (animals, etc.), though [http://wot.wikia.com/wiki/Wotwiki_talk:Chapter_summaries this] is the closest I can come to finding it now.  In retrospect, I probably should have asked for others opinions instead of doing that reversion... [[User:Rccarman|Rccarman]] 21:45, 23 May 2006 (UTC)
::: After looking at it more closely I'm inclined to agree that there is too much detail there.  I don't think we need to get into stuff like Dogs and Horses, for instance... Let us limit ourselves to things that are unique to the WoT universe, shall we?  For instance I could see Ravens and Rats being relevant in later chapters, but not any old animal and other common things... --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 22:47, 23 May 2006 (UTC)
